summary: Iteration 96 - P2+P3 Batch Testing Complete. All 18 backend tests passed. Portal V2 features fully functional: login, dashboard with 6 tabs, ticket messaging, KB access. TicketsPage and TechniciansPage load correctly after config refactor.
